plan.title: Dynamic Tabs - direct AEM implementation
plan.summary: Create the Dynamic Tabs component in the Scotia AEM Author repository using model-free HTL and a composite multifield. Converted 15 repository operation(s) from unambiguous FileVault paths; source/build-only files are not deployed.
steps: Verify the AEM Author connection and unused component path.
Create component metadata, composite multifield dialog, HTL and clientlib resources.
Read back repository resources and test dialog persistence and tab interaction.

repositoryOperations.content: ${panelTab.valueMap.content @ context='html'}

assumptions: Target is the connected local AEM 6.5 Author.
Direct-JCR rendering uses model-free HTL; the Java Sling Model is source-preview only and is not deployed.
risks: core/models/DynamicTabsModel.java: Java source is retained in the source preview; direct JCR writes do not compile or activate bundles.
apps/site/components/dynamicTabs/component.json: Codebase manifest only; not a JCR resource.
validationChecks: Confirm the dialog stores tabs as composite child resources with title/content properties.
Confirm HTL emits tablist, tab buttons and tabpanels.
Confirm CSS and JS clientlib category and indexes.
Test click and keyboard navigation on a page in AEM Author.
